title: PORCH MEMORY ROUTINE
description: Each evening, companions, neighbors, and visiting pets can leave small remarks, found objects, and weather complaints on the farmhouse porch.
consequence: The porch starts saving a chair.

title: COMPANION EPILOGUE LETTERS
description: Finished companion arcs now end with handwritten letters, keepsake objects, and a quiet goodbye scene instead of looping daily favor requests forever.
consequence: The story learns how to say goodnight.

title: FRIENDSHIP STAMP ALBUM
description: Companion bonds now fill stamp pages with tiers, checkmarks, foil borders, and repeatable visit marks instead of messy little remembered conversations.
consequence: The relationship becomes a punch card.

title: AUTO-ROSTER CLEANUP
description: Inactive squadmates now slide into an archived roster with generic status tags, compact portraits, and no old mission notes cluttering the team screen.
consequence: The squad list learns to forget politely.
